title: Ball moved by the wind after a stroke
question: Your ball comes to rest after a stroke, but then the wind blows it somewhere else. According to the rules, how do you play on?

choices.text: Replace the ball to its original resting spot
Play the ball from its new position
Add a penalty and replace the ball
Replay your previous shot from the old spot

explanation: If the wind or gravity moves your ball after it has come to rest from a stroke, you must play it from its new position, with no penalty.

juniorVersion.title: What to do if the wind moves your ball after you’ve hit
juniorVersion.question: You hit your ball and it stops. But then, the wind blows your ball to a different place. What should you do next?

choices.text: Put the ball back where it stopped the first time
Play the ball from where the wind moved it
Add a penalty and put the ball back
Hit your shot again from the old spot

juniorVersion.explanation: If the wind moves your ball after it has stopped, you play the ball from the new spot. You don’t get a penalty.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A stroke is when you swing your club to try to hit the ball.
At rest means your ball has stopped rolling or moving.

juniorVersion.teachingTip: Let children see how wind or gravity might move a ball after it stops, and practise playing from where it gets moved.
likelyMisconceptions: Children may think they always have to put the ball back where it stopped the first time.
They may think a penalty is needed if the wind moves the ball.
